Merge master branch with octree tile coordinate fixes

Fix Tile3D constructor parameter order in explicit tiling

The splitLevelTile was being created with parameters in wrong order (z, x, y) instead of (x, y, z). This caused the TileSelector3D to not properly match child tiles, resulting in no external tileset files being generated at the split level.

Co-authored-by: bertt <538812+bertt@users.noreply.github.com>

Fix: Exclude splitLevel tiles from root tileset in explicit tiling

Both QUADTREE and OCTREE were including splitLevel tiles directly in the root tileset AND adding external tileset references, causing duplication. Now root tileset only includes tiles from 0 to splitLevel-1, with external tileset references (e.g., tileset_2_3_2.json) for splitLevel and higher tiles.

Co-authored-by: bertt <538812+bertt@users.noreply.github.com>

Fix: Create external tilesets when maxlevel equals splitLevel

Changed condition from `maxlevel > splitLevel` to `maxlevel >= splitLevel` in both QUADTREE and OCTREE explicit tiling. This ensures external tileset.json files are created even when the maximum tile level equals the calculated split level, preventing empty root tilesets.
